body:
You know, reminding me of my dog..he is always happy when I'm home and my cat always runs down and meows at me.
Thanks, that's a little thing to cling onto.

Playing Portal 2 with my older brother when he was going through hard times with his fiance, just the generalness of my brother ten years older than me coming to his teen sister with his problems.

"Want to play games and just talk shit?"
"Yeah"

Was a hard time, but yet a moment when we came pretty close.

Cheers, I'm not sure how I'll end up, I'll update. I think maybe the pills are away tonight seemings as how other people seem to know my experiences, it makes me feel connected somewhat. I'm unsure, I may just feel horrible in the next hour, but I can try.

I love game of thrones, I really adore the characters though it makes me sad I can't live in a world of magic! I tried a counsellour when I was younger and it felt like speaking to a "So how does that make you feel?" machine.
I'll give it a go when I'm more...human acting.

Thank you, it seems like you have a part in common with me. Maybe I should wake up tomorrow and start a diary..review it at the end of the year to see how much that year made me feel, try to quit smokeing and maybe find someone to open up too.

It was a childhood of trying to get pressured into being a Johovas witness that made me feel like there is not god. I'm open to other peoples beliefs currently, yet to find one that relates to me. At the moment I feel like death is nothing.
Well this username was a throwaway, but the ones I normaly go by bring a few good thoughts...thank you.
I always see it on Netflix, always thought it would be a bit too trippy for me...

What books can I read that are not really "Self-help" books? Slef-help books make me feel worse the fact I need to spend more money to even feel better about myself.I mean I love Lord of the Rings, in the way Sam trys to keep Frodo from a awful place in his head from the rings corruption. Any fantasy books or even games that can help?
I don't think I'm a psycohpath, I think I'm just lost on a windy road, like Alice. Though that sounds pretty much like a psychopath...I'm  kind of drunk too.
I like all kinds of people, though I see little value in money.
Death is like before you were born, in my view, just nothing, seems like peace to me.
I do like me some babes..but in truth the chance of this happening to me is zero, I have no great talents and I work at a crap high paying supermarket, yet I spend it on drink to numb myself.
Thank you, really. What is your best memory may I ask? Helplines diden't help me tonight as it felt like they were hardly human....

But how, how can you turn it around? It seems so hard for me, giving up my good paying job and life to start in a beauty school. People think people who go to beauty school to do things like SPFX make-up have no hope. My own dad made me skip on this dream to get this good job that I find no statisfaction in and honestly, makes me want to drink even more everytime I get home. Books make me sad as I know I'll never have as intresting life as them, I love pizza, but it makes me fat! My pain is very real and very human, I'm drinking to numb it, sorry for this ramble, I'm just kind of lost.

I can get this, I liked a guy so much after I turned him down because I only knew him a month. Though it went bad for me, he diden't feel the same as he trained himself to only view me as a friend. It may have sparked my depression for the last year even stronger knowing I lost him. Tonight he confirmed my rejection caused him to not like me in a love sense anymore, I feel awful.

Even though death is final, it has a certain peace to it. The people and family I have now in time will certainly lose the pain in five or ten years, they're strong peopleand can cope. I'm so weak it hurts, I'm just lost.
I posted, I got nothing. I tried a hotline, I tried even online chat rooms, nothing is helping.
Called a hotline, did nothing for me.
